notes.title: Maid of Sker is on Steam Daily Deal!
notes.content:
[h3]The award-winning survival horror Maid of Sker is now on sale with 60% off for a limited time only! 👻[/h3]

Wander the halls of Sker Hotel with 3D sound-based AI system as the core survival mechanic and realistic visuals featuring 4k uncapped on PC (1080p 60fps minimum). Uncover the chilling story inspired by Welsh folklore combining psychological, gothic and British Horror!

[previewyoutube=Ewkx5eBlOEs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🎁⛄Don't miss out on our Wales Interactive Massive Festive Giveaway🎅🎄[/h3] 

Win awesome prizes including a Maid of Sker Teddy Bear, Maid of Sker T-shirt, Maid of Sker Mug, Maid of Sker Stickers, Maid of Sker Limited Edition Vinyl, The Shapeshifting Detective Boxed Edition AND Digital Game Codes.

[url=https://gleam.io/w6M4i/wales-interactive-massive-festive-giveaway]Enter our Giveaway Now[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33855640/4d4bbe3cbd4afae45532cdf97b63f304c818d18e.png[/img]

[h3]Try our NEW Challenge mode!🔫 [/h3]

The new modes showcase a brand new set of game mechanics with the introduction of first-person shooting amongst some new and familiar enemies from Sker Hotel, each buffed with their own unique powerful abilities.

[previewyoutube=6lyGF9poBAc;full][/previewyoutube]

Enter Sker Hotel... the Quiet Ones are waiting for you...
